_comment: Narration per scene. A line with "cue": n starts when that scene's nth caption appears; "at" is seconds into the scene. "say" overrides the text sent to the voice (pronunciation only).

card-intro.text: Meet Cambio. Get paid in MUSD, and prove it on-chain.
card-intro.say: Meet Cambio. Get paid in M U S D, and prove it on chain.

card-problem.text: Getting paid in crypto is still broken. Long addresses. Links anyone can edit. Screenshots as proof.

landing.text: It's a non-custodial payment app, built for Mezo's bitcoin-backed stablecoin.

username.text: First, connect a wallet and claim a username. Instead of a forty-two character address, people can simply pay you by name.
Pick a name, and Cambio checks that it's available.
Your wallet signs the claim, and the server verifies that signature before saving the name.

request.text: Next, create a payment request, with an amount, a note, and an expiry.
Your wallet signs it, using EIP-712.
request.say: Your wallet signs it, using E I P seven twelve.

request.text: Share it as a link or a QR code. Change any detail, and the signature breaks.
request.say: Share it as a link, or a Q R code. Change any detail, and the signature breaks.

pay.text: The payer opens the link. Before any pay button appears, their browser checks that the request really was signed by the recipient.
Then they connect their wallet, and review the payment.
Every detail is shown up front.
Cambio then runs a live check against Mezo Testnet: the payer's balance, and the fee for this exact transaction. The request ID travels inside the transaction, so payment can be proven on-chain.
pay.say: Cambio then runs a live check against Mezo testnet: the payer's balance, and the fee for this exact transaction. The request I D travels inside the transaction, so payment can be proven on chain.

tamper.text: If anyone edits the link, say, to ten times the amount, the signature check fails, and Cambio refuses to offer payment.

swap.text: Balances are read straight from the chain.
And swaps go through Mezo's official router, with live quotes and on-chain pool fees.
swap.say: And swaps go through Mezo's official router, with live quotes, and on chain pool fees.

card-outro.text: Cambio. Verified names, signed requests, on-chain proof. Try it now on Mezo Testnet.
card-outro.say: Cambio. Verified names. Signed requests. On chain proof. Try it now, on Mezo testnet.
